outline.text: Gold still heavy: levels to watch for shorts
My 15-minute chart shows a clear series of lower highs. Below, there is a pocket of support where I expect buyers to show up.

outline.alt: Chart preview for XAUUSD: bearish trend line rejection

outline.text: Price is respecting the falling trend line under strong selling pressure on the hourly chart. I am waiting for a lower high to confirm.

outline.alt: Chart preview for Gold 4H: market structure shift

outline.text: The four-hour structure has turned. A break of the last higher low suggests the correction may not be finished yet.

outline.alt: Chart preview for Crude oil squeezes into resistance

outline.text: Oil is pushing into a zone that capped price twice before. A clean break could trigger a quick run higher.

outline.alt: Chart preview for Natural gas: seasonal strength kicks in

outline.text: Natural gas: seasonal strength kicks in
Historically this is the stronger part of the year for gas. The chart agrees, with a base forming above support.

outline.alt: Chart preview for Silver: are you buying the dip here?

outline.text: Silver: are you buying the dip here?
Silver had a remarkable run. This first real pullback is a test of conviction for the trend followers.

outline.alt: Chart preview for GBPUSD: bearish momentum on the 1H

outline.text: The pound keeps failing at the same resistance band. Until that changes, rallies look like selling opportunities.

outline.alt: Chart preview for EURUSD update — clean and clear

outline.text: The structure keeps printing lower highs and lower lows. I will stay with the trend until it breaks.

outline.alt: Chart preview for EURUSD short: one failed recovery at a time

outline.text: EURUSD short: one failed recovery at a time
Hello traders, here is my technical outlook based on the 3H chart. Each bounce has been weaker than the last.

outline.alt: Chart preview for USDJPY buyers defend a key level

outline.text: USDJPY buyers defend a key level
The pair bounced right off a level that has mattered all year. Bulls stay in control while it holds.

outline.alt: Chart preview for Dollar index: is this the high of the year?

outline.text: Dollar index: is this the high of the year?
Just a simple rising channel with price now at the top edge, which lines up with the seasonal tendency.

outline.alt: Chart preview for Cable at a decision point

outline.text: Two scenarios are on the table. A daily close above the range keeps buyers happy; below it the door opens to the lows.

outline.alt: Chart preview for Apple coils under resistance: breakout or one more pullback?

outline.text: Apple coils under resistance: breakout or one more pullback?
Price has tested the same ceiling three times this month. Volume is drying up, which usually comes before a bigger move in either direction.

outline.alt: Chart preview for Chip leaders cool off after a parabolic run

outline.text: Chip leaders cool off after a parabolic run
Momentum is fading on the daily chart and RSI shows a lower high. I am watching the 50-day average as the first real support.

outline.alt: Chart preview for EUR/USD slips out of its summer range

outline.text: EUR/USD slips out of its summer range
The pair finally closed below the range floor. A retest from below would confirm the breakdown and open room toward the next shelf.

outline.alt: Chart preview for Gold pauses at a big round number

outline.text: Gold pauses at a big round number
After a sharp rally gold is moving sideways. I would like to see a clean higher low before adding to longs.

outline.alt: Chart preview for Bitcoin weekly: the trend line still holds

outline.text: Bitcoin weekly: the trend line still holds
Zooming out helps. The rising trend line from last year is intact, and every dip into it has been bought so far.

outline.alt: Chart preview for Tesla forms a textbook descending triangle

outline.text: Tesla forms a textbook descending triangle
Lower highs against flat support. These patterns often resolve lower, but a strong close above the upper line would flip the picture.

outline.alt: Chart preview for NVDA: ascending triangle points to continuation

outline.text: NVDA: ascending triangle points to continuation
Hello traders, here is my updated view on the weekly timeframe. The structure keeps building higher lows into a flat top.

outline.alt: Chart preview for Meta holding its consolidation zone

outline.text: Price has been trading in a clean range. Buyers keep stepping in at the lower edge, so I am treating it as support until proven otherwise.

outline.alt: Chart preview for AMD gap fill complete — what next?

outline.text: AMD gap fill complete — what next?
The gap from last month is now closed. The next level to watch is the prior breakout area just below current price.

outline.alt: Chart preview for Microsoft: steady uptrend with shallow pullbacks

outline.text: Microsoft: steady uptrend with shallow pullbacks
Each pullback has been smaller than the last one. That is the kind of quiet strength I like to see in a leader.

outline.alt: Chart preview for Amazon tests the 200-day average

outline.text: The long-term average has acted as a floor twice this year. A third successful test would be a constructive sign.

outline.alt: Chart preview for Alphabet: momentum divergence on the 4H chart

outline.text: Alphabet: momentum divergence on the 4H chart
Price made a new high but momentum did not follow. Not a sell signal by itself, but a reason to tighten stops.
